subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

There have been heavy rains in the city __even then hurricane made landfall. __

options.text: then the hurricane is made landfall

solution:
The correct answer is **'since the hurricane made landfall'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is not **grammatically correct.**
 
• The underlined segment is **erroneous** here.
 
• We need to substitute the underlined segment with the sentence from the following options:
 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect tense and in this case since will be used to introduce an action or an event as a reason for something related in the past.
 
• Therefore, we will substitute since here in the underlined segment and, thus the correct answer is **option 2.**

 

***Correct Sentence**: There have been heavy rains in the city **since the hurricane made landfall**. *
